newsitem.title: USA: Leach tells Democrats to wait on Fed hearing.
newsitem.headline: Leach tells Democrats to wait on Fed hearing.

text.p: House Banking Chairman Jim Leach told a group of Democrats on his panel Thursday that he was inclined to wait until the next Humphrey Hawkins hearing rather than hold a special hearing on the Federal Reserve's recent interest rate increase.

"The precedent of holding a hearing on every quarter point shift in interest rates is troubling, particularly given the U.S. economic expansion is entering its seventh consecutive year with high levels of employment and relatively low inflation," the Iowa Republican said in a letter.
On Thursday, all but three of the 24 Democrats on the committee asked Leach for a prompt hearing on the Fed's recent action.
Leach said the next hearing with Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan on monetary policy was scheduled for July.
An additional day or two of testimony would be appropriate to get the views of outside experts from business, labor and academia.
